So far 17 behavior scenarios are settled:

- Fast saving with automatic page details and a manual fallback
- Optional tags, tag suggestions, and near-duplicate tag prevention
- Search across titles, descriptions, and tags
- Exact tag filtering
- Read-later marking, viewing, unmarking, and empty guidance
- Opening, editing, and safely deleting bookmarks
- Duplicate-link prevention
- Clear handling of invalid addresses, empty searches, and failed saves

Notes, saved page copies, archiving, and smarter cleanup of tracking-heavy addresses remain deferred.

May I start implementing this approved scope?
